Only 22% of remote USD jobs list a pay figure. The rest say DOE — determined on experience. That leaves you guessing the salary that matches your skills.

From our analysis of 4,280 active remote listings:
• 940 listings (22%) disclose a concrete USD salary
• 3,340 listings (78%) leave pay blank, signaling DOE
• 64% (2,735) accept applicants from any country
• 1,213 listings posted in the last 7 days

Example: Online Consumer Panels America pays $25–$45/hour for product assessments. Others like Clearance Jobs (Sr Principal Pilot), Valor Healthcare (Licensed Therapist), and Mercy (Remote Radiologist) imply DOE.

DOE isn't always a red flag. It can be a negotiation lever. With rare skills like AI or senior leadership, you can push above market averages. Employers use DOE to stay flexible and attract broader talent.

How to negotiate DOE effectively:
1. Research global benchmarks
2. Quantify your impact with metrics
3. Anchor with a high-end range
4. Ask about total compensation
5. Reference industry trends
